body:
CustomTags is a lightweight Paper plugin that lets players create their own colored custom tag, shown in chat and in the tab list.

Players can set a tag with `/ct <tag> <color>`, disable it with `/ctoff`, and enable it again with `/cton`.  
Operators can use `/ctoff all` and `/cton all` to disable or enable all tags globally.

## Commands
- `/ct <tag> <color>` — Sets your custom tag
- `/ctoff` — Disables your own tag
- `/cton` — Enables your own tag again
- `/ctoff all` — Disables all tags globally (OP only)
- `/cton all` — Enables all tags globally (OP only)

## Features
- Colored custom tags in chat and tab list
- Supports named colors and hex colors
- Instant updates without restart
- Global tag toggle for admins
- Simple and lightweight

## Config
The plugin includes a config file where you can customize:
- Maximum tag length
- Whether hex colors are allowed
- Allowed tag characters / regex
- Chat formatting
- Tab formatting
- Brackets, separator, spacing, and colors
- Global tag system enabled / disabled

This makes it easy to match the plugin to your server’s style.
